title: Optimize Evals 1:1 prep - examples & actions (2026-03-18)
content:
Goal: quick sync to align on the regression signal from last week's A/B, confirm next steps for prompt-set/hypothesis triage, and agree on owners for rollback vs tuning.

Context / TL;DR:
- A/B (canary vs stable) run 2026-03-12 -> 2026-03-15 showed a ~4.8% drop in automated relevance metric (R@1-precision) for conversational summarization workload (prompt-set 'cs-v2').
- Signal concentrated in shorter-turn dialogues (<= 4 turns) and queries with lists/step-by-step answers.
- Recent changes in serving: quantization profile Q4-beta rolled to canary on 2026-03-10 (PR 542), and a kernel switch for attention op on a subset of GPU types (ENGINF-8921).
- We also changed a prompt normalization tweak (trim trailing punctuation) in the prompt pipeline for canary on 3/9 (OPT-345). Any one or combination could cause the degradation.

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick walk-through of the A/B numbers (Jamie) — 5 min
   - confirm scope: traffic split, sample size, confidence bounds
2) Failure examples review (me) — 7 min
   - show 6 canonical failures across prompt types (see examples below)
3) Hypotheses & triage plan — 10 min
   - prioritize testing rollback of prompt normalization vs quantization vs kernel change
4) Decide immediate remediation & owners — 5 min
5) Quick sync cadence for next 72h and follow-ups — 3 min

Important metrics to have ready (ask Jamie to surface in meeting):
- R@1, BLEU-ish / ROUGE-lite we were using for cs-v2 (both canary & baseline)
- Distribution of sequence length, latencies (p50/p95), and token count by turn
- Error rates / timeouts/ OOMs by node type since 3/9

Failure examples (copy these into the deck)
- EX1 (short list prompt): expected: includes numbered steps; canary: drops items, merges lines -> semantics lost
- EX2 (multi-step instruction): canary adds hallucinated step not in source
- EX3 (multi-list intersection): misses intersection items -> lower precision
- EX4 (few-shot with bullet context): output becomes verbose and repeats context lines
- EX5 (short Q + list answer): returns single sentence summary instead of enumerated list
- EX6 (edge-case with emoji/markdown): formatting removed, mis-ordered bullets

Initial hypotheses (ranked):
1) prompt-normalization tweak (trim punctuation) removed disambiguating cues for list extraction -> higher impact on short-turn list prompts (high prior).
2) quantization (Q4-beta) introduced small numeric instability for the model path used by cs-v2 (affects token ranking).
3) attention kernel change interacts with long-key caching for short-turn patterns (less likely but non-zero).

Quick triage plan (72h windows)
- Step A (immediate, 0-6h): rollback prompt-normalization on canary and re-run a fixed 2k sample from cs-v2. Owner: Eva (me) + infra ops (Samir). Link: OPT-345 rollback branch.
- Step B (6-24h): run the same sample with stable quantization profile (force stable Q profile on canary nodes) to isolate quantization. Owner: Jamie + eng-serving (ENGINF-8921 testing env).
- Step C (24-48h): if regression persists after A+B, spin up a tiny canary with kernel switch disabled (or force previous kernel) and run full A/B. Owner: Eng PL (TBD) + Samir.
- Step D (24-72h): narrow down by prompt subset (lists vs instructions vs code-like) and compute per-subset delta. Owner: Eva + analytics (Aisha).

Decisions to make in meeting
- Do we roll back prompt-normalization on production canary now or wait for quick A analysis? (My leaning: rollback now because low risk and likely culprit.)
- If rollback fixes >60% of delta on quick sample, keep canary while quantization investigation continues.
- If rollback doesn't move needle, consider emergency rollback of Q4-beta on canary (higher cost/risk).

Action items (capture for follow-up)
- Eva: run rollback of prompt-normalization on canary and run 2k sample; post results to thread; due EOD 2026-03-18.
- Jamie: export updated A/B table with CIs, sample sizes, and per-prompt-type deltas; share before meeting.
- Samir: stand by to flip quantization profile for canary nodes in test env and help collect logs; ready by 6-12h.
- Aisha: run fine-grained slice analysis (lists vs instructions vs short-turn) and produce a CSV with deltas; due 2026-03-19 morning.
- Eng (owner TBD): prepare plan to toggle attention kernel fallback for a small canary; estimate time/cost.

Notes / open questions (to bring up)
- Any scheduled deployments for stable that we should block? (I think none until 3/25.)
- Are there existing rollback runbooks for Q profile? (Samir - confirm)
- Could prompt-normalization have been enabled in other pipelines inadvertently? (check SDK shipping code paths)

Quick reference links to paste in meeting chat:
- A/B dashboard (internal): https://internal.redwood.ai/ab/cs-v2?run=2026-03-12_to_2026-03-15
- PR for Q4-beta: https://github.com/redwood-inference/realtime-serve/pull/542
- OPT ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPT-345

Personal notes / reminders 
- Keep meeting focused on root-cause isolation, avoid scope creep into rollout policy redesign.
- If rollback chosen, communicate to customer-success + SRE on potential perf differences.
- After we stabilize, follow-up: add targeted evals (prompt-subset based) to continuous regression test harness.

Draft message for post-meeting thread (pasteable):
"Summary: agreed to rollback prompt-normalization on canary (Eva) and run quick sample; Jamie to provide per-prompt deltas; Samir to assist with quantization toggles if needed. Next sync 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Owners and tickets in OPT-345."
